approval_source: Explicit reviewer confirmation in ChatGPT conversation

comment_scope.ownership: Each comment belongs to exactly one valid task; workspace scope is derived from task and parent project
comment_scope.access: Backend authorization required for the relevant workspace and resource
comment_scope.cross_workspace_or_invalid_reference: Reject without disclosing foreign resource details

deletion.policy: Permanent deletion by author or authorized workspace administrator within applicable permissions

activity_event_coverage: membership invitations, additions, removals, role changes, and ownership changes
project and task creation, updates, and relationship changes
task assignment and reassignment, status, priority, and due-date changes
applicable security-sensitive mutations, authentication-related events, and session invalidation

visibility.policy: Resource-authorized workspace members; narrower access for privileged administrative/security events where required

retention.policy: Append-only activity history retained for workspace lifetime
retention.workspace_deletion: Separate explicit authorized policy, subject to applicable audit and legal retention obligations

verification_obligations: authorized comment creation, editing, and deletion
owners and managers cannot moderate comments outside their workspace
cross-workspace references and reads are rejected without information leakage
comment deletion creates a unique durable audit event without deleted text
events contain required identity, actor, timestamp, type, and resource references
safe before/after values are captured where applicable and secrets excluded
history access follows resource authorization after membership or role changes
ordinary application operations do not silently lose, duplicate under the same unique identity, or rewrite required history
failed mutations do not leave partial business changes or misleading success events
event coverage is traceable to TaskFlow acceptance criteria and negative tests

limitations: This record documents chat approval only.
It is not a cryptographic attestation or trusted evidence envelope.
Implementation and runtime verification remain unestablished by this decision.
